tools.name: world
tools.description: Manage the Truman Town simulation. Use 'action' to select: init | reset | tick | inject_event | list_scenarios | get_agent | get_timeline | get_story | get_snapshot (read saved world).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Operation: init, reset, tick, inject_event, list_scenarios, get_agent, get_timeline, get_story, or get_snapshot.

parameters.name: scenario
parameters.description: Preset scenario ID from list_scenarios; used by init/reset when spec is not provided.

parameters.name: spec
parameters.description: Custom world specification for init/reset; takes precedence over scenario.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: World language: zh or en. Defaults to zh on init/reset; tick can change it.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Number of simulation ticks for tick; defaults to 1. The App invokes one tick per request.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Director event payload required by inject_event; queued for the next tick.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Resident ID required by get_agent; optional actor/target filter for get_timeline.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum events returned by get_timeline; defaults to 30 and is clamped to 1-100.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Optional exact event-type filter for get_timeline.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Optional day-number filter for get_story; omit to return all retained stories.
